data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Amineh means tranquility and hope. It is derived from the Arabic word 'amin' which means trust and belief in God. It is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of patience, hope, and faith. The name Amineh carries the meaning “Tranquility, Hope” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amineh usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquility, hope and live with faith, good character and purpose.
